title: Vintage Couple Standing Outdoors, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from around the mid-1940s featuring a couple standing together outdoors on a grassy hillside with trees in the background. The man is dressed in a short-sleeved white collared shirt and pleated trousers, while the woman wears a tailored dark skirt suit with structured shoulders and a classic mid-century hairstyle.
